opportunities.title: Cronos Just Proved 'Immutable' Was Always a Marketing Word
opportunities.why_now: Cronos executed a full chain rollback to claw back $111M from the Tectonic exploit, yet $9.2M still walked away — a live case study in what 'code is law' actually means when it's inconvenient.
opportunities.angle: Explainer/op-ed dissecting the rollback mechanics and the precedent it sets for every L1 that claims immutability, with the $9.2M shortfall as proof rollbacks don't even work cleanly

opportunities.title: Liquid's 'White Hat' Story Is the Most Convenient Hack Narrative of 2026
opportunities.why_now: An attacker took $320M, returned $270M+ 3,400 BTC, kept ~600 BTC, and the network is now negotiating with them like a business partner — a pattern our readers have seen before and know rarely ends clean.
opportunities.angle: Skeptical timeline piece questioning the 'white hat' framing, comparing to past exploit-then-negotiate playbooks, and asking what happens to the retained 600 BTC

opportunities.title: The Coldcard 'Wave 3' Attacker Is Cashing Out — Here's What Hardware Wallet Owners Missed
opportunities.why_now: Galaxy confirms the Coldcard exploiter has moved 45% of Wave 3 stolen funds, meaning the theft is transitioning from breach to liquidation in real time.
opportunities.angle: Security-focused breakdown of the Coldcard attack vector and why hardware wallet users assumed they were safe from exactly this

opportunities.title: Zondacrypto's Body Count Hits Five — This Is What a $100M Exchange Fraud Prosecution Actually Looks Like
opportunities.why_now: Polish prosecutors just charged a fifth suspect and are seeking pretrial detention, turning what looked like an isolated hack into a coordinated fraud operation.
opportunities.angle: Legal-process explainer tracking the expanding suspect list, framed as a template for how exchange collapses eventually unravel into criminal charges

opportunities.title: Malone Lam's Plea Hearing Is a Reminder: Social Engineering Beats Every Cold Wallet
opportunities.why_now: The $245M Bitcoin theft case is heading to a plea hearing, closing the loop on one of the largest social-engineering heists in crypto history.
opportunities.angle: Retrospective on the Lam case as a case study in why human-layer security failures dwarf protocol-layer ones, tying to the current wave of hacks in the news
